tasks.title: Create preflight.sh
tasks.description:
NEW deploy/linux-runner/preflight.sh. Verify Linux service user and secret modes plus unattended Git and headless agent probes

REVIEW FAIL (code): Anonymous ref reads bypass credential verification — TR-004, unattended pilot Git authentication.
  WHERE: deploy/linux-runner/preflight.sh:86-90 and tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh:516-521
  EXPECTED: Preflight exits 1 when the supplied pilot Git credential is rejected, even if the repository allows anonymous ref reads.
  ACTUAL: The only remote check is `git ls-remote --exit-code "$GWRK_PILOT_REPO_URL" HEAD`. The container fixture returned HEAD without credentials and preflight exited 0 with `GH_TOKEN=revoked`.
  FIX: Require a bounded authenticated check using the supplied credential against the configured repository. Keep the ref-read probe and require the new anonymous-read regression to pass.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T019, gate: gates/phase-05.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: deploy/linux-runner/preflight.sh — Keep the bounded `git ls-remote --exit-code` probe. Strip the GitHub URL prefix and optional `.git` suffix to derive `slug`. Require `timeout --kill-after=2s 20s gh api --hostname github.com --method GET --silent "repos/$slug/commits?per_page=1"` with the loaded `GH_TOKEN`. Suppress command output and exit 1 on failure. In `tests/linux-runner/bundle-and-live-record.test.ts`, run preflight with stubbed commands that return HEAD anonymously and reject `GH_TOKEN=revoked` for that exact endpoint. Assert exit 1 for the revoked token and exit 0 for the accepted token. Mirror both cases in `tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh` and update the TR-004 plan entry. [GitHub REST authentication](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/authentication/authenticating-to-the-rest-api)
FIX: deploy/linux-runner/README.md — Run `init --non-interactive`, `db backup`, and `db restore` as `gwrk` through `node /opt/gwrk/current/dist/cli.js` with `GWRK_HOME=/var/lib/gwrk` and `GWRK_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/gwrk`. Run init from the pilot checkout. Install the configured root-owned probe and provision the credential files before `systemctl enable --now gwrk-runner.service`. In `tests/linux-runner/bundle-and-live-record.test.ts`, exercise the documented commands with `gwrk` absent from `PATH`. Assert that backup captures a service-ledger sentinel, restore recovers it, and the probe and credentials exist when enablement runs. Record the regression in `specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/plan.md`.
FIX: tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh — Install `manifest.yaml` and `adapter.js` for the approved `fixture` backend under `/var/lib/gwrk/plugins/agents/fixture`. After the `SIGKILL` restart, submit a fresh committed pilot feature and phase through `POST /api/dispatch`. Have the worker executable record start and completion and wait on a bounded release signal. While it waits, assert `GET /api/dispatch/queue` shows exactly one active dispatch with the returned ID and that the fixture records one live worker. Release it and require successful completion. Preserve the lock, restore, and rollback checks. Assert that backup manifests preserve both seeded run 42 and the new dispatch run ID, then update the TR-003 plan entry.
